keyDelivery.question: How do I receive my game key?
keyDelivery.answer: Keys are delivered instantly by email and are always available in your account dashboard.

deliverySpeed.question: Is delivery instant?
deliverySpeed.answer: Yes. Most purchases are fulfilled within seconds, and we will notify you if anything delays delivery.

paymentMethods.question: What payment methods do you support?
paymentMethods.answer: We accept major debit/credit cards and trusted local processors for secure checkout.

paymentFailed.question: My payment failed. What should I do?
paymentFailed.answer: Double-check your card details, try another payment method, or contact your bank. If it still fails, reach out to support.

refundRequest.question: Can I request a refund?
refundRequest.answer: Refunds are possible for unused keys and accidental purchases. Submit a request within 14 days for review.

issueKey.question: My key is not working. What should I check?
issueKey.answer: Make sure the region matches your account, double-check for typos, and confirm the key has not been redeemed before.

accountSecurity.question: How do I secure my account?
accountSecurity.answer: Use a strong password, enable two-factor authentication, and avoid sharing your login details.

emailChange.question: Can I change the email linked to my account?
emailChange.answer: Yes. Head to account settings to update your email. You may be asked to verify the change.

languageSupport.question: Which languages does support speak?
languageSupport.answer: Our support team helps in English, Russian, Ukrainian and Polish, and game language availability is listed on each product page.

orderStatus.question: Where can I see my order status?
orderStatus.answer: All orders and invoices are available in your account dashboard under “Orders & Payments.”

about.purposeTitle: Games should be easy to find, safe to buy, and yours to keep.
about.purposeLead: Tale Shop started with a simple frustration: buying PC games online meant sketchy resellers, hidden region locks, and support that vanished after checkout. So we built the store we wanted — curated, secure, and honest from the first click to long after the download finishes.
about.missionText: Connect players with games they’ll love — minus the friction and the fine print. Every listing shows its activation region and refund terms before you pay, not after, and the key lands in your inbox the moment the payment clears.
about.visionText: Become the digital game store players genuinely trust, everywhere we operate. Trust here is not a slogan: it is published policies, reviews we do not curate, and a support thread that stays open until your problem is actually solved.
about.promiseText: If a key fails, we replace it or refund it — no forum archaeology, no proving you are not a fraudster. Account recovery and two-factor setup are written down in full, so you always know what happens next.
about.principlesTitle: Principles we don’t cut corners on.
about.principlesText: Four commitments that shape every part of the store — each one you can check for yourself.

curation.title: Player-first curation
curation.text: We stock games worth your time — handpicked by people who play, not dumped in bulk.

security.title: Security you can see
security.text: Two-factor auth, backup codes, and an account-recovery process we publish in full.

fair.title: Fair and upfront
fair.text: Refund rules and region details are shown before you buy — never sprung on you after.

support.title: Support by real players

where-is-my-game-key.question: Where is my game key?
where-is-my-game-key.answer: Keys are delivered instantly after successful payment. If your bank is reviewing the payment, delivery may take a bit longer. If it’s been over 30 minutes, refresh your Orders page and check the order status. Still missing? Contact support with your order number.

how-do-refunds-work.question: How do refunds work?
how-do-refunds-work.answer: Refund eligibility depends on the product and whether the key was revealed or activated. If a key wasn’t revealed, a refund is usually possible under our policy. If a key was revealed or used, refunds are typically not available. See Refund policy for details.

payment-charged-order-missing.question: Payment was charged but order is missing
payment-charged-order-missing.answer: Some payments appear as “pending” or authorization before the order is created. Wait 10–30 minutes and refresh your Orders page. Also check you’re logged into the correct account/email. If it still doesn’t show up, contact support with the payment receipt/transaction ID.

download-invoice.question: How to download an invoice?
download-invoice.answer: Go to Account → Orders → select your order → Download invoice (PDF). If the invoice button isn’t available yet, the order may still be processing. If you need it urgently, contact support and we’ll help.

activate-steam-key.question: How to activate a Steam key?
activate-steam-key.answer: Open Steam → Games → Activate a Product on Steam… → enter your key → confirm. If you see a region or “invalid” error, check Regional restrictions or make sure you’re redeeming on the correct platform.

secure-account.question: How to secure my account?
secure-account.answer: Use a strong, unique password and don’t reuse it elsewhere. Enable 2FA if available and never share your keys or password. If you suspect suspicious activity, change your password immediately and contact support.

items.question: How do I receive my game key?
items.answer: Keys are delivered instantly after a successful payment. You'll find them in your account under Keys, and we also email a copy to your registered address.

items.question: Is delivery really instant?
items.answer: For in-stock titles, yes — most orders reach your inbox within seconds. If a key needs manual review, we'll notify you and deliver as soon as it clears.

items.question: Where do I redeem my key?
items.answer: Each product page lists the platform (for example Steam). Redeem the key in that platform's client under 'Activate a Product' to add the game to your library.

items.question: Which payment methods do you accept?
items.answer: We accept major cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express) and secure processors via Stripe. Your card details are handled by the payment provider and never stored on our servers.

items.question: Can I change the currency?
items.answer: Yes — use the currency switcher in the header. Displayed prices are indicative; your card is charged in the store's settlement currency shown at checkout.

items.question: Is checkout secure?
items.answer: Checkout runs over an encrypted connection through a trusted payment processor, with buyer-protection safeguards on every order.

items.question: What is your refund policy?
items.answer: If a key doesn't work or you can't access your purchase, contact us and we'll make it right — a replacement key or a refund. Full details are on our Refund policy page.

items.question: My key won't activate — what should I do?
items.answer: First confirm you're redeeming it on the correct platform and region. If it still fails, reach out through support with your order ID and we'll resolve it quickly.

items.question: Do I need an account to buy?
items.answer: An account keeps your keys, orders and receipts in one place, and lets support verify your purchase faster. You can create one in seconds from the Sign up button.

items.question: I've lost access to my account.
items.answer: Use account recovery to regain access. If you're still stuck, contact support and we'll help verify your identity and restore your account.

items.question: Which languages does support cover?
items.answer: Our team and AI assistant help in English, Russian, Ukrainian and Polish, and each product page lists the languages available for that game.

items.question: How do I manage the newsletter or unsubscribe?
items.answer: Every newsletter email has a one-click Unsubscribe link in the footer — no sign-in needed. If you have an account, you can also switch the deals newsletter on or off in Account → Settings → Notifications. Unsubscribing only stops marketing emails; order receipts and security emails still arrive.

discount.a: No. The order costs what it costs. A share of what you paid comes back as store credit and waits on your balance until you want it.

howMuch.aSingle: {{percent}}% of what you paid, on every order.
howMuch.aRange: From {{min}}% to {{max}}% of what you paid, depending on your level. The level depends only on how much you have spent in total — everyone starts at {{start}}%.

whenSpend.a_one: Cashback is credited when the order is paid and the key is issued, and shows as pending for {{count}} day while the order can still be refunded. After that it is yours to spend on any order.
whenSpend.a_other: Cashback is credited when the order is paid and the key is issued, and shows as pending for {{count}} days while the order can still be refunded. After that it is yours to spend on any order.

returns.q: What if I return an order?
returns.a: The cashback earned on that order goes back with it. If you have already spent it, the balance can go to zero, but never below.

expires.aMonths_one: Cashback is valid for {{count}} month from the day it was earned, and the oldest is always spent first, so nothing burns while you are using it.
expires.aMonths_other: Cashback is valid for {{count}} months from the day it was earned, and the oldest is always spent first, so nothing burns while you are using it.
expires.aNever: No. Cashback stays on your balance until you spend it.

level.a: No. Levels depend on your total spend, and that number only grows.

cashbackTerms.holdRule_one: Cashback is credited when the order is paid and the key is issued, and is held for {{count}} day first.
cashbackTerms.holdRule_other: Cashback is credited when the order is paid and the key is issued, and is held for {{count}} days first.
cashbackTerms.holdNow: Cashback is credited when the order is paid and the key is issued, and can be spent right away.
cashbackTerms.expiryRule_one: Cashback is valid for {{count}} month from the day it was earned.
cashbackTerms.expiryRule_other: Cashback is valid for {{count}} months from the day it was earned.
cashbackTerms.noExpiry: Cashback does not expire: it stays on your balance until you spend it.
cashbackTerms.emailsOff: We do not send cashback emails at the moment; your balance and expiry dates are always shown in your account.
cashbackTerms.emailsReminder_one: We email you when cashback becomes available and about {{count}} day before any unspent part expires. You can turn these emails off from a link in any of them; your balance is not affected.
cashbackTerms.emailsReminder_other: We email you when cashback becomes available and about {{count}} days before any unspent part expires. You can turn these emails off from a link in any of them; your balance is not affected.
cashbackTerms.emailsOn: We email you when cashback becomes available. You can turn these emails off from a link in any of them; your balance is not affected.

activation-guide.title: Activation guide
activation-guide.shortDescription: Step-by-step activation tips for popular platforms.
activation-guide.intro: Redeeming a key takes a couple of minutes. Find your platform below and follow the steps — and keep your order number handy in case anything goes wrong.

callout.title: Keep your key private
callout.text: Anyone who sees your key can activate it. Never share screenshots of a revealed key — not even with people claiming to be Tale Shop support.

sections.title: Before you start
bullets: Make sure the platform account you plan to redeem on is the right one.
Check the product page for platform and region details.
Keep your order number handy in case you need help.
Bought a software key (Windows, Office, antivirus, VPN)? Those activate with the vendor — see Activating software.

sections.title: Redeem on Steam
bullets: Open Steam and go to Games → Activate a Product on Steam…
Enter your key exactly as shown and confirm the activation.
If you see a region warning, review Regional restrictions before retrying.

sections.title: Redeem on other platforms
bullets: Visit the platform’s official redeem page (Epic, EA, Ubisoft, etc.).
Sign in and enter the key in the redeem or activation field.
Restart the launcher to see the game in your library.

software-activation.title: Activating software
software-activation.shortDescription: How to redeem licence keys for operating systems, office suites, security and other apps.
software-activation.intro: A software key is activated with the vendor, not on a game platform. The product page tells you where: the vendor’s website, your Microsoft account or the app itself. The same place is shown next to the key in your account and in the delivery email.

callout.title: Keep your key private
callout.text: Anyone who sees your key can activate it on their own devices. Never share a revealed key — not even with people claiming to be Tale Shop or vendor support.

sections.title: Before you start
bullets: Check the system requirements on the product page — a revealed key cannot be returned because the app does not run on your device.
Make sure you sign in to the account you want the licence on. Most vendors cannot move an activated licence to another account.
Keep your order number handy in case you need help.

sections.title: Activate on the vendor’s website
bullets: Copy the key from Account → Keys or from the delivery email.
Open the vendor’s licence page — the link is on the product page — and sign in or create a free account.
Enter the key in the licences or subscriptions section.
Install the app and sign in with the same account on each device the licence covers.

sections.title: Activate with a Microsoft account
bullets: Sign in to your Microsoft account in a browser.
Choose to redeem a code or product key and enter the key exactly as shown.
The product is added to your account; install it from there. Windows keys can also be entered in Settings → System → Activation.

sections.title: Activate inside the app
bullets: Download the app from the vendor’s official website or the app store linked on the product page.
Open it and find the licence, registration or “Enter key” option.
Enter the key; the app confirms the licence and the term it covers.

sections.title: Term and devices
bullets: The licence covers the term and number of devices shown on the product page, for example “1 year · 3 devices”.
When the term starts — on purchase or on activation — is decided by the vendor. If the product page does not say, activate soon after buying.
To add another device, sign in to the same vendor account on it. Removing a device in the vendor account usually frees its place.
Subscriptions bought here cover the stated term and are not renewed by Tale Shop. Renewing through the vendor is a separate purchase with them.

sections.title: If activation fails
bullets: Check that you are in the right place — a vendor key does not work in the Microsoft Store, and the other way round.
Retype the key instead of pasting it if the vendor reports an invalid format.
Open the order in your account and request help. We verify the key and, if it is faulty, replace it or refund you.

refund-policy.title: Refund policy
refund-policy.shortDescription: Understand eligibility and how to request a refund.
refund-policy.intro: We keep refunds simple: unrevealed keys are usually covered, revealed keys are not — because we can no longer verify they haven’t been activated.

sections.title: Eligibility basics
bullets: Unrevealed keys are generally eligible for refunds.
Revealed or activated keys are typically non-refundable.
Some products have additional publisher restrictions.

sections.title: How to request a refund
bullets: Go to Account → Orders and open the order you want to refund.
Select Request refund and provide a short reason.
We will email you once the request is reviewed.

sections.title: Processing time
bullets: Most refunds are reviewed within 24–48 hours.
Approved refunds are returned to the original payment method.
Bank processing can take 3–10 business days.

payment-methods.title: Payment methods
payment-methods.shortDescription: Supported cards, regions, and checkout tips.
payment-methods.intro: Everything about paying at Tale Shop: what we accept, how to avoid failed payments, and how your card data is protected.

sections.title: Supported options
bullets: Major debit and credit cards (Visa, Mastercard, AMEX).
Select local payment options where available.
Bank transfers are available for selected regions.

sections.title: Checkout tips
bullets: Match your billing address to your bank records.
Use a stable connection to avoid timeouts.
If a payment fails, wait a few minutes before retrying.

sections.title: Security
bullets: Payments are encrypted and processed securely.
We never store full card numbers on our servers.
Enable 3D Secure or bank verification when prompted.

regional-restrictions.title: Regional restrictions
regional-restrictions.shortDescription: Know where a key can be activated and used.
regional-restrictions.intro: Publishers can lock keys to specific regions. A minute of checking before purchase saves a support ticket after.

sections.title: Why restrictions exist
bullets: Publishers may limit keys to specific regions.
Pricing and licensing rules differ by country.
We display region details on every product page.

sections.title: How to check your region
bullets: Compare the product region with your account country.
Check the platform store region before redeeming.
If unsure, contact support before revealing the key.

sections.title: If you see an error
bullets: Do not keep retrying—errors can lock the key temporarily.
Take a screenshot of the error message for support.
We can verify the region and advise next steps.

account-recovery.title: Account recovery & 2FA
account-recovery.shortDescription: What to do if you lose access to your authenticator or backup codes.
account-recovery.intro: Lost your phone with the authenticator app? Ran out of backup codes? Don’t panic — go through the self-service options first, then request a manual recovery if nothing works.

callout.title: How we protect recovery
callout.text: Support will never disable two-factor authentication instantly. Every recovery request is identity-checked and deliberately delayed — this is exactly what stops attackers from stealing accounts by impersonating their owners.

sections.title: Try these first
sections.intro: Most lockouts are solved in a minute without contacting support:
bullets: Use a backup code: on the sign-in page enter your password, choose “Try another way” and pick “Recovery authentication codes”. Each code works once.
Still signed in on another device or browser? Open Account → Security there and re-configure two-factor authentication.
Replaced your phone? Restoring the authenticator app from its own backup (e.g. Google Authenticator account sync) usually brings your codes back.

sections.title: Request account recovery
sections.intro: If none of the above works, ask us to reset your second factor:
bullets: Fill in the recovery form (button above) — it works without signing in.
Provide your account email, one or two recent order numbers and the last 4 digits of the card you paid with.
We verify ownership against your order and payment history, so expect follow-up questions.
Recovery includes a waiting period of up to 72 hours. We notify your account email at every step, and you can cancel the request from any active session.
Once verified, we reset your second factor. On the next sign-in you will set a new password and re-enable 2FA.

sections.title: What we will — and won’t — ask for
bullets: We may ask for: your account email, recent order IDs, the last 4 digits and exact amounts of recent payments.
We will never ask for your password, a full card number, or codes from your authenticator app.
If anyone claiming to be Tale Shop asks for those, it is a scam — please report it to us.

callout.text: Recovery requests are only discussed via the email addresses involved in the request. We never process them in live chat or social media.

sections.title: Avoid getting locked out again
bullets: Generate a fresh set of backup codes and store them offline — print them or keep them in a password manager.
Keep a second trusted device signed in to your account.
Keep your account email verified and up to date — it is the channel we use to confirm recovery.

terms-of-sale.title: Terms of sale
terms-of-sale.shortDescription: What you buy, how it is delivered, and the rules around it.
terms-of-sale.intro: These terms describe what happens when you buy a game or software key from Tale Shop: what exactly you receive, when it is delivered, and what each side is responsible for.

sections.title: Who you are buying from
bullets: Tale Shop is operated by {{entity}}, registered in {{registrationCountry}}, registration number {{registrationNumber}}.
Registered address: {{address}}.
For anything about an order, write to {{supportEmail}} — that address is monitored by our support team.

sections.title: What you are buying
sections.intro: This is the part people most often misunderstand, so it comes first.
bullets: You buy a licence key, not a copy of the game itself. The key unlocks the game on the platform it belongs to.
The game is delivered and run by that platform — Steam, Epic Games or another store named on the product page. We are neither its publisher nor its operator.
When you redeem the key, the platform’s own agreement applies to your use of the game. We cannot change or override it.

For software, you buy a licence key for the term, number of devices and edition shown on the product page. The software is provided by its vendor, and the vendor’s licence agreement applies once you activate it.
A software subscription covers the term you paid for. It is not renewed automatically through Tale Shop.

sections.title: Where the key works
bullets: Some keys are limited to a region. The product page shows whether this applies before you buy, based on the country you selected.
A key used outside its region will not activate. That is how the key was issued by the publisher — it is not a defect.
Choose your country correctly at checkout. If it is wrong, the key you receive may be unusable.

callout.text: How regions work, and how to tell whether a key suits you, is explained in Regional restrictions.

sections.title: Prices, currency and taxes
bullets: Prices are shown in the currency you select and already include the tax we are required to charge (such as VAT). Tax is never added on top: the checkout shows how much of the total it makes up, based on your country.
The price that applies to your order is the one shown at the moment you pay — later price changes do not affect a completed order.
Your bank or payment provider may add its own conversion fee. We do not receive it and cannot refund it.

sections.title: Delivery
bullets: Keys are delivered electronically. Nothing is shipped physically.
After a successful payment the key appears in your account and is sent to the email address used for the order.
If you ordered as a guest with an unverified address, we hold the key until you confirm that address through the link we email you.

sections.title: Immediate delivery and your right to withdraw
sections.intro: Digital goods are handed over the moment you pay, and that changes what can be undone afterwards.
bullets: Before paying you confirm that you want the key delivered immediately.
By confirming this you accept that once the key has been revealed to you, the purchase can no longer be withdrawn — the key cannot be taken back or resold.
Until a key is revealed, the rules in our Refund policy apply.
{{withdrawalWording}}

callout.text: We record this confirmation with your order: the date, the exact wording you were shown, and its version.

sections.title: If a key does not work
bullets: Check the activation guide first (for software — Activating software) — most failures are a wrong platform or a mistyped character.
Open the order in your account and request help, or write to {{supportEmail}} with the order number.
We verify the key on our side. If it was already used, invalid, or issued for the wrong region, you get a replacement or a refund.
Requests are usually answered within 24–48 hours.

sections.title: Order checks
bullets: We may review an order before releasing the key if the payment looks unusual.
We may ask you to confirm the email address or the payment used.
If we cannot complete a check, we cancel the order and return the money in full. We do not keep a fee for a cancelled order.

sections.title: Your account and fair use
bullets: Keep your account credentials to yourself. Orders placed from your account are treated as yours.
Keys bought here are for your own use. Bulk buying for resale is not allowed without a written agreement with us.
Disputing a payment with your bank instead of contacting us first may suspend your account while we investigate. Talking to us is faster and usually solves it.

sections.title: What we are responsible for
bullets: We are responsible for delivering a valid key for the product you bought, in the region stated on the product page.
We are not responsible for the game itself — its content, updates, servers, or a publisher removing it from a platform.

For software, we are not responsible for how the program works, its updates, or the vendor ending support. Check the system requirements before buying: a revealed key cannot be returned because the software does not suit your device.
We are not responsible for losses we could not reasonably foresee, or for a platform account being lost or banned by its operator.
{{liabilityLimits}}

sections.title: Law and disputes
bullets: These terms are governed by the law of {{governingLawCountry}}.
If something goes wrong, write to us first — {{supportEmail}}. Most disputes end there.
{{disputeForum}}

sections.title: Changes to these terms
bullets: We may update these terms; the version in force is the one published here.
The terms that apply to your order are the ones published when you placed it.
Material changes are announced on the site before they take effect.

privacy-policy.title: Privacy policy
privacy-policy.shortDescription: What we collect, why, and what you can ask us to do with it.
privacy-policy.intro: This policy describes the data Tale Shop actually handles: what we store, why we store it, who else sees it, and how you can have it removed.

sections.title: Who is responsible for your data
bullets: The controller is {{entity}}, {{address}}.
Questions about your data go to {{privacyEmail}}.
{{dataProtectionOfficer}}

sections.title: What we collect
sections.intro: Only what the shop needs to sell you a key and prove that it did.
bullets: Your email address — it is where keys and receipts go, and it identifies your account.
Your orders: what you bought, when, in which currency, for which country, and the keys issued to you.
Your confirmation that keys should be delivered immediately, with the wording you were shown.
Technical data: IP address, browser and device details, and the pages you opened.
Support conversations and anything you send us in them.

callout.text: We never see or store your card number. Card details go straight to our payment provider; we only receive the result of the payment.

sections.title: Why we are allowed to use it
bullets: To perform the contract: without your email and order we cannot deliver a key or prove that we did.

cookie-policy.title: Cookie policy
cookie-policy.shortDescription: What we keep in your browser, and what you can switch off.
cookie-policy.intro: Tale Shop keeps very little in your browser, and nothing at all for advertising. This page lists what is stored, why, and what happens when you decline.

sections.title: Cookies are not the only thing that counts
sections.intro: Most of what the shop keeps is not a cookie at all — it is browser storage, which never leaves your device and is not sent with every request. The rules treat both the same way, so both are listed here.
bullets: On a first visit, before you sign in or accept anything, the shop sets no cookies whatsoever.
What it does store locally: your cart, the language, currency and country you picked, and an anonymous id used to keep your own reading and funnel events apart from other visitors’.
Cookies appear later: when you sign in, and — only if you allow it — when analytics starts.

sections.title: Strictly necessary — cannot be switched off
sections.intro: Without these the shop cannot do what you asked it to do.
bullets: Sign-in session: set by our sign-in provider when you log in, and removed when you log out.
Cart: what you put in it, kept so it survives a page reload.
Your choices: language, currency and country, so the shop does not ask again on every page.
Your cookie choice itself: without storing it, the banner would ask you on every single page.

sections.title: Analytics — only if you allow it
bullets: We use Google Analytics 4 to see which pages people use and where they get stuck.
It is not loaded at all until you accept analytics cookies. Decline, and the script is never fetched, so no analytics cookies are set.
You can change your mind at any time through Cookie settings in the footer. Withdrawing consent stops further collection.
We do not use cookies for advertising, and we do not sell what analytics collects.

callout.text: What analytics collects and how long it is kept is described in the Privacy policy.

sections.title: How to control it
bullets: Open Cookie settings in the footer to review or change your analytics choice.
Use your browser settings to delete what is already stored — the shop will treat you as a new visitor afterwards.
Signing out removes the sign-in session.

cashback-terms.title: Cashback terms
cashback-terms.shortDescription: How cashback is earned, held, spent and taken back.
cashback-terms.intro: Cashback is store credit, not money: it can be spent on orders at {{entity}} and cannot be withdrawn, transferred or exchanged for cash. These terms say exactly when it appears, when it can be used and when it goes away.

sections.title: How it is earned
bullets: Cashback is earned by signed-in customers. Orders placed without an account (as a guest) do not earn it, even if an account is created with the same email later.
Every order paid by card on the website earns cashback at the percentage of your level at the time of the order. Orders paid with cryptocurrency or through the Telegram bot do not earn it for now.
The percentage is applied to the amount you actually paid, after discounts and promo codes. Our prices include tax, so tax is not deducted from that amount.
The part of an order paid with cashback earns nothing — cashback does not earn cashback.
Your level depends only on your total spend on eligible orders. Refunded orders do not count, and nothing else raises or lowers it.

sections.title: When you can spend it
bullets: While held it shows as pending and cannot be spent.
The hold covers the window in which an order can still be refunded or charged back.
Once the hold passes, the amount becomes available and can be put towards any order paid by card on the website.
Cashback works together with discounts and promo codes. It can cover most of an order, but at least {{cashbackMinCardPayment}} (or the equivalent in the order currency) is always paid by card.
Your balance is kept in US dollars. In another currency it is shown and spent at the current exchange rate, so the amount you see can change slightly with the rate.

sections.title: When it is taken back
bullets: If an order is refunded or reversed, the cashback earned on it is taken back, and cashback you used to pay for that order is returned to your balance.
A partial refund takes back a proportional part.
If the cashback has already been spent, the balance can fall to zero — never below, and we will not ask you to pay it back.
Cashback obtained through abuse of the programme may be cancelled along with the account.

sections.title: Expiry
bullets: {{cashbackExpiryRule}}
Each amount expires on its own schedule; spending some does not reset the clock on the rest.
The oldest cashback is spent first, so nothing expires while newer credit is being used.
{{cashbackEmailsRule}}

sections.title: Changes to the programme
bullets: Percentages and thresholds may change; cashback already earned keeps the terms it was earned under.
If the programme is discontinued, you will have at least 30 days to spend the balance you have.

callout.title: Cashback is not money
callout.text: It is a discount on future orders at {{entity}}. It cannot be withdrawn, transferred to another account or exchanged for cash, and it is not a payment instrument.
